in_marathi.name: Ekdantika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ekdantika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Ekadanta’, meaning ‘One-Tusked’. This name is believed to be a tribute to the one-tusked god, Ganesha, who is revered for his strength and wisdom.
